svg.title: Mert Ali ERENTÜRK - Data & AI Engineer
svg.desc: Data pipelines, lakehouse design and LLM applications. A downward scan reveals the pixel portrait while the name, role, description and handle are typed letter by letter in parallel. The portrait makes a sixteen-view turn showing front, side and back views, then returns to its initial pose for the upward erasing scan. Reduced motion keeps the initial portrait and all text visible.
